name: Boards, controllers & PLCs
blurb: Control boards and programmed PLCs. We designed most of the originals, so we know what replaces what.

name: Solenoids
blurb: Complete solenoids, coils only, brackets and kits for full height and waist high turnstiles.
aside: Never lubricate solenoid plungers or coils. Lubricant + time = adhesive.

name: Springs
blurb: Pawl, main, centering and connecting springs. Ours are annealed and plated so they last on the shelf and in the field.
aside: F = -kx is Hooke's Law. Boing is Oops's Law.

name: Microswitches & sensors
blurb: Rotation and limit microswitches, actuators, activator disks and optical sensors.
aside: A one-way microswitch folds one way and stays rigid the other. A two-way stays rigid both ways. The factory has always gotten this backwards.

name: Bearings & cams
blurb: Top and bottom bearings, flanges, thrust discs, cams and the grease to go with them.

name: Pawls, linkages & hardware
blurb: Pawls (some folks call them dogs), linkages, studs and the hardware that holds it all together. Where we don't have them, we make them.

name: Relays
blurb: Control, time delay, plug-in and solder-in relays for Robot, Burle, Philips, Tomsed and Alvarado.

name: Power supplies & transformers
blurb: Transformers, rectifiers, power supplies and fuses.

name: Shock absorbers & speed control
blurb: Shock absorbers, governors, brake pads and self-centering kits.

name: Lamps, switches & enclosures
blurb: Indicator lamps, LED sets, pushbuttons, key switches and enclosures.

name: Counters
blurb: Mechanical and electric passage counters and accessories.

name: Mechanical assemblies
blurb: Complete hub, shaft, ratchet and lock assemblies, with exploded drawings so you can find the piece you need.

name: Sliding gate parts
blurb: Parts for Burle, Philips, Tomsed and Boon Edam slide gates: AHSG, CHSG, SHSG and THG-51.

name: Maintenance tools
blurb: The tools we use on these machines every day.

name: Used turnstiles
blurb: Restored and used turnstiles when we have them.

name: Bargain bin
blurb: New old stock and odd lots at a discount while they last.
